title: The owner's twin switch proposable from the chat on a card, and the Home build bound to what its card showed
request: The owner's goal (the stop hook): every agentic system behind the chat, the owner's switches included, the person deciding.
spec: the remaining gaps: the twin switch, store runs and the campaign from the chat, the Home build keyed
plan: key the Home build to its card
relay the twin switch on a card
live: the twin switch, the keyed build, the campaign and the store from the chat

decisions.decision: The agent proposes the owner's twin switch; the person turns it on a card
decisions.why: the owner decides, as every relayed decision; R&D checks the owner's role with sign-in

decisions.decision: Store runs stay commands the person approves
decisions.why: they write the training store; the chat runs them as Claude Code runs a project's commands

change: R&D chat_agents.py (home_build shown), tests. dclab-code config.js (twin relay, holdout pattern), guards.js (the relay's note), engine.js (buildShown's shown), dclab_person.js (comment), tests.

findings.defect: a Home build was not tied to the card the person saw
findings.scenario: the card shows outcome churn; the draft changes before Allow; home_build built the new one
findings.cause: home_build took only the person's words
findings.fix: the card's fields go with the Allow as shown; R&D refuses a draft that changed on any shown field; the host replaces any shown the agent passed

findings.defect: the owner's twin switch could not be proposed from the chat
findings.scenario: the agent reached the twin but could not ask the person to turn it on
findings.fix: relayed on a card that says it is the owner's switch and what it spends, only on and DCLab's bounded caps; built-in object names refused as keys

findings.defect: turning the twin switch was asked as a holdout read
findings.scenario: the switch's card said it reads the holdout
findings.fix: only a project's twin run and a draft's twin messages are holdout asks

measurements.name: live from the chat
measurements.gate: each step the person's, on a card that shows what is sent
measurements.result: twin off then on at EUR 0.3 a run; the keyed Home build: ROC-AUC 0.8047 (0.789 to 0.822); the campaign on Claude Sonnet 5 from a command: 5 calls, CV ROC-AUC 0.687; store status --brief: 51,088 entries, 4.2 GB; $0.44

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 105 of 105; R&D test_chat_agents and test_agents_validator 34

outcome: Every R&D agent and the owner's twin switch are reachable from the chat, each person's step on a card bound to what it showed.
lessons: A pattern that matches a path's word (twin) matches every route with it: name the routes that do the thing.
risks: the twin card's spend note does not read the current sample setting
